type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: formalize exact multistate S_N decay gap theorem

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.RiemannMultistate.multistate_SN_gap_closes_RH
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {Scalar : Type} (chain : MCore.RiemannMultistate.ZeroOneTwoTensionedChain Scalar),   MCore.RiemannMultistate.WeightedModularBilinearDecayGap Scalar chain.SN →     ∀ (transport : MCore.RiemannMultistate.RHTransport Scalar), transport.RH

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.RiemannMultistate.multistate_presentations_do_not_multiply_gaps
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {Scalar : Type} (x : MCore.RiemannMultistate.MultistateSN Scalar) (p q : MCore.RiemannMultistate.Presentation Scalar),   p ∈ x.presentations → q ∈ x.presentations → p.value = q.value

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.RiemannMultistate.one_to_two_iff_weighted_decay_gap
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {Scalar : Type} (chain : MCore.RiemannMultistate.ZeroOneTwoTensionedChain Scalar),   MCore.RiemannMultistate.WeightedModularBilinearDecayGap Scalar chain.SN ↔     Nonempty (MCore.RiemannMultistate.WeightedDecayEndCertificate Scalar) ∧ ∃ endCert, endCert.SN = chain.SN
